papers.title: A dual-phase Ti-6.5Al-2V-2Mo-1Nb-14Zr-0.1Si alloy with superior 600 °C strength and ductility developed from Ti-6Al-4V cluster formula
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, China

corresponding_authors.name: Chuang Dong
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Dalian Jiaotong University, Dalian 116028, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及从Ti-6Al-4V集群公式开发的新型合金，但并非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳研究。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on a new alloy composition (Ti-6.5Al-2V-2Mo-1Nb-14Zr-0.1Si) and its high-temperature properties, without any AM processing or Ti-6Al-4V mechanical/fatigue characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发一种新型双相钛合金，在600°C下兼具高强度和高塑性。
summary_zh.method: 基于Ti-6Al-4V集群公式设计和制备Ti-6.5Al-2V-2Mo-1Nb-14Zr-0.1Si合金。
summary_zh.result: 该合金在600°C下表现出优异的强度与塑性组合。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和微观组织表征验证合金性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a novel dual-phase titanium alloy with high strength and ductility at 600°C.
summary_en.method: A Ti-6.5Al-2V-2Mo-1Nb-14Zr-0.1Si alloy was designed and fabricated based on the cluster formula approach derived from Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibits superior strength and ductility at 600°C, outperforming conventional Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural characterization were performed to validate the alloy's performance.
